EmailTemplate.subject: Financial Care Chronicle: Year End Round Up!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Welcome to the final healthcare newsletter of 2020!
As we look to close out the last days of 2020 and turn our attention to 2021, we thought it would be prudent to take a brief moment to reflect on our collective accomplishments during such difficult times.
Undoubtedly, it starts with the health systems we partner with. Despite the many challenges that came in 2020, the vision, compassion, and resilience providers have shown has been truly inspiring. During a time when patients find themselves not only concerned about their health but also their personal finances, these health care providers have been proactive in supporting patients with flexible payment options.
As the pandemic continues, patients will need that consideration more than ever in 2021 and we’re committed to helping our clients meet this challenge.
For our part, Flywire navigated a very successful acquisition of Simplee, utilized our platform to help our clients engage patients with responsive payment support, signed and deployed a record number of health systems even during the peak of the pandemic, and focused on providing timely, thought leadership to the market that hopefully helped providers make informed decisions regarding their business at critical times during the year (you can find highlights of that content below).
Thank you for reading and have a safe and happy new year! We’ll see you in 2021!
-John Talaga, EVP & GM Healthcare, Flywire. Highlights from our record breaking webinar program. [Webinar] How 3 top health systems are preparing for 2021 Edward Elmhurst Health, Dayton Children's Hospital, and Penn Highlands Healthcare share how they're preparing their revenue cycles following one of the most pivotal years in healthcare history. [Webinar] Building a modern financial experience Banner Health and AdventHealth join forces to discuss how to build a modern patient financial experience that increases collections and delights patients all-in-one. [Webinar] Power Through Options Leslie Richard, System Vice President of Revenue Cycle at CommonSpirit Health details how to empower patients by giving them the financial options to help themselves. Stories from patients. Learnings from providers. How to get projects done during Covid-19 Communication, tight coordination, and perseverance. Learn the key aspects to a great implementation via an in depth look at Banner Health's point-of-service roll out during the height of Covid-19.
